svg.title: Three conditions place the residual map inside the Birkhoff polytope: non-negative entries, unit row sums, unit column sums.
svg.desc: Non-negativity avoids sign cancellation, a row sum of one fixes each output stream scale, and a column sum of one conserves the global mean across streams; together the three conditions make the residual map a doubly stochastic matrix with spectral norm at most one.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Three Birkhoff conditions define the target matrix

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Together they place the residual map inside the Birkhoff polytope.
